profiles.label: iPhone Duo
profiles.badge: Closed Duo video trial · acceptance pending
profiles.validation: One closed-display Duo session rendered BruTV's local H.264 HLS fixture. After a 666.58-second pause, physical Play restored video in 3.28 seconds, and source counters advanced in later captures. Full posture and orientation behavior, repeatable cold startup, general app performance, and complete profile acceptance remain pending.
profiles.postures: Closed · book · open · partial native checks
profiles.note: One closed-display BruTV session rendered the local H.264 HLS fixture. After a 666.58-second pause, physical Play restored playback in 3.28 seconds; source counters advanced in later captures. Earlier native checks exercised layout and selected controls across cover and software inner displays. These are narrow trials, not broad playback or performance results. Full posture and orientation behavior, repeatable cold startup, and complete profile acceptance remain pending. The virtual inner display is composited onto one visible cover framebuffer; physical hinge behavior and a second physical scanout are not emulated.

profiles.label: iPhone 16
profiles.validation: The compatible-graphics iPhone profile scenario and 26-step CounterLab functional smoke passed. DataMigrator success: false still blocks clean creation acceptance.
profiles.note: A fresh iPhone 16 guest on iOS 27.0.1, build 24A446, completed ordinary Setup Assistant through the UI. In compatible graphics, the 12-step iPhone profile scenario and 26-step CounterLab smoke passed. The smoke covered counter actions, semantic scrolling and taps, Details navigation, Unicode input (Hello from Linux ✓), Home, and count 1 after app terminate/relaunch. The note is transient; its persistence was not tested. DataMigrator success: false leaves clean creation unaccepted. One closed-Duo video recovery trial and iPad display-classification recovery have also been demonstrated, but repeatable cold guest startup, app performance, and complete device acceptance remain pending.
profiles.source: Compatible iPhone app smoke · acceptance pending

profiles.label: iPad mini (A17 Pro)
profiles.badge: Native app metrics and touch · acceptance pending
profiles.validation: One iPad mini guest completed migration and ran CounterLab built with SDK 27.2. The app visibly reported iPadOS 27.0.1, iPad idiom, 744 × 1133 points and 2× scale, and its count changed after a physical touchscreen tap. Automated inspection still refuses unknown FrontBoard orientation; the full profile scenario has not passed.
profiles.postures: Portrait app metrics and physical touch observed
profiles.note: The native framebuffer matches the 326 PPI profile. In one preserved guest with completed migration, CounterLab displayed the expected UIKit metrics and responded to a physical tap. Automated UI inspection remains blocked: FrontBoard reports unknown orientation while an independent SpringBoard getter reports portrait. Large binary-stream uploads also failed; a hash-verified file-write RPC installed the app. Full creation, automated profile acceptance, repeatable cold startup and general performance remain unverified.
profiles.source: Native iPad app trial · acceptance pending
